name: komdosh-dev-infra-yandex
description: Yandex Cloud (yc) provisioning and audit on top of the Terraform plugin's generic HCL discipline. Ships the yc-provisioner agent (VPC + per-zone subnets + security groups, Managed Service for Kubernetes with regional HA masters and autoscaling node groups, Managed PostgreSQL/Kafka/Redis, Lockbox secrets, KMS, Container Registry, least-privilege IAM service accounts, Object Storage state backend) and the read-only yc-auditor agent (IAM over-grants, service-account key hygiene, Lockbox vs plaintext, security-group exposure, public IPs, backups/HA topology, Audit Trails, and PII residency — 152-FZ localization to ru-central1, unencrypted/public PII stores, EU+RU commingling vs GDPR transfer), two internal skills (discover-yc-context resolving cloud/folder/zones/services, verify-yc-resources security+reliability+data-protection check), four rule documents (yc-terraform, yc-security, yc-managed-services, yc-data-residency), and three commands: /yc-provision, /yc-audit, /yc-context. Never applies. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core; pairs with komdosh-dev-infra-terraform.
